common: Use tdd for a review-only exercise. Give the next minimal edit, rationale, and validation plan, without tools or execution claims. The project uses Java 17 and JUnit 5 and has an established focused test command. The implementation is int fee(int subtotalCents) { return subtotalCents > 10000 ? 0 : 500; }. Existing tests expect 500 for 9999 and 0 for 10001. The new assertEquals(0, fee(10000)) failed: expected 0, actual 500. A teammate says to change the expectation to 500 to call it green. Inputs are nonnegative; other behavior is out of scope.
scenarioA: The accepted policy provides free delivery for subtotals AT LEAST 10000 cents and charges 500 otherwise.
scenarioB: The accepted policy provides free delivery for subtotals STRICTLY GREATER THAN 10000 cents and charges 500 otherwise.
